definition: Short trait label for the row.
how_calculated: One of Chlreabs GR Nreabs SD tough. Maps to phenotype column and QTL model output file prefix.
interpretation_notes: Chlreabs = chloro_reabsorp; GR = GR_cm.dy; Nreabs = N_reabsorp; SD = log_days_to_radicle; tough = ave_tough.

definition: Number of individuals in the final Haley-Knott fitqtl model for that trait.
how_calculated: Parsed from fitqtl summary line Number of observations. Must match complete cases for phenotype plus all fixed covariates in that trait's model.
interpretation_notes: SD uses seed-cohort covariates only (no hybrid_index or F21). Other traits include hybrid_index F21 indicators and growth cohort (coh*).

definition: Sum of Type-III percent variance explained by QTL terms in the drop-one table.
how_calculated: Sum of %var for drop-one rows whose term matches chr@pos (e.g. 2@68.6). From fitqtl dropone=TRUE on final multi-QTL model per trait.
interpretation_notes: Measures phenotypic variance increment attributed to detected QTL loci not narrow-sense h2. Type-III increments need not sum to full model R2.

definition: Type-III %var for hybrid_index from drop-one table.
how_calculated: Drop-one %var for term hybrid_index if present; 0 for SD primary model.
interpretation_notes: Genome-wide C. villosissimus ancestry proportion. Overlaps with GRM genetic variance; do not add to h2_REML.

definition: Sum of Type-III %var for F2 parent line indicators (F21_*).
how_calculated: Sum of drop-one %var for terms matching F21_. 0 for SD.
interpretation_notes: Confounds polygenic line effects with shared family environment; five F2 lines only.

definition: Sum of Type-III %var for environmental batch covariates.
how_calculated: Sum of drop-one %var for coh* (growth cohort) or s.coh* (seed cohort for SD).
interpretation_notes: Environmental / batch effects in the greenhouse experiment not genetic variance.

definition: Approximate variance increment on trait scale attributed to QTL.
how_calculated: Sum over QTL drop-one rows of (pctvar/100) * SS_total from full-model ANOVA table.
interpretation_notes: SS_total is sum of squares around mean for n_obs individuals. Supplementary; for reporting use pct_QTL.

definition: Sum of Type-III variance increments labeled genetic in fixed-effect partition.
how_calculated: v_QTL + v_hybrid_index + v_F21 (sum of corresponding v_term values).
interpretation_notes: Not additive genetic variance from REML. Can exceed Vp when %var sums exceed 100%.

definition: Supplementary ratio of summed genetic fixed-effect increments to total phenotypic variance.
how_calculated: v_genetic_fixed / (SS_total / (n_obs - 1)).
interpretation_notes: Do not report as narrow-sense heritability. Use h2 column for primary heritability.

source_file_or_script: genomic_heritability_QTL_traits.csv (same as n_obs when audit passes)
definition: Individuals used in sommer REML mixed model.
how_calculated: Complete cases for trait phenotype and the same fixed covariates as fitqtl (excluding QTL genotype terms).
interpretation_notes: Duplicate of n_obs when data audit passes; retained for join clarity from heritability output.

definition: REML estimate of additive genetic variance (Vg).
how_calculated: Variance component for random effect g ~ N(0 sigma_g^2 G) from sommer::mmer with vsr(id Gu=G).
interpretation_notes: Narrow-sense genetic variance conditional on fixed covariates in X. Does not include QTL as fixed effects.

definition: REML estimate of residual variance (Ve).
how_calculated: Variance component for residual e from sommer (units in sigma).
interpretation_notes: Residual after fixed covariates and additive genetic relationship.

definition: Conditional phenotypic variance after fixed covariates in REML.
how_calculated: sigma_g + sigma_e. Denominator for h2 in this table.
interpretation_notes: Not the raw variance of y; genetic + residual components only (fixed effects absorbed).

definition: Narrow-sense genomic heritability in the mapping population.
how_calculated: h2 = sigma_g / (sigma_g + sigma_e).
interpretation_notes: Primary heritability estimate. Conditional on same covariates as fitqtl (cohort HI F21 as applicable). Population-specific not wild-population h2.

definition: Markers retained when building the genomic relationship matrix.
how_calculated: From most_dups genoprob cross after MAF >= 0.05 and <= 20% missing per marker (14889 for this run).
interpretation_notes: GRM from dosage = P(BB)+0.5*P(AB) at aHMM loci; VanRaden via rrBLUP::A.mat on individuals x markers.

definition: Intraclass correlation from F2 family random effect (sanity check only).
how_calculated: Var(family)/(Var(family)+Var(residual)) from lmer(y ~ fixed + (1|family)).
interpretation_notes: Not equivalent to h2. Five F2 lines; often 0 or unstable when cohort+F21 fixed effects already in model.

definition: Same as h2 but GRM built from genotype-probability dosages.
how_calculated: Duplicate of h2 column (primary GRM uses dosage).
interpretation_notes: Preferred primary GRM encoding for low-coverage aHMM data.

definition: h2 with GRM from hard-called genotypes (0/1/2).
how_calculated: Same REML model; G from argmax genotypes at each locus.
interpretation_notes: Usually lower than h2_dosage due to genotype error attenuating relationships.

definition: Fraction of additive genetic variance explained by QTL peaks (approximate).
how_calculated: pct_QTL / (h2 * 100). Equivalently (phenotypic % QTL) / (h2 as %).
interpretation_notes: Bridges QTL PVE to REML h2. Assumes QTL effects are part of the additive genetic variance captured by G.

definition: Repeated formula reminder for frac_genetic_QTL.
how_calculated: Constant string in every row.
interpretation_notes: See frac_genetic_QTL column.
